people.name: Eber
people.line: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan

people.name: Peleg
people.line: Descendant of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
